fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The "N active league runs" text was rendered as an extra `<tr>` at the top of the `<tbody>` in both the React table (`table.jsx`) and the static Mustache fallback (`decktable.mustache`). This made the table one data row taller than intended, causing misalignment between the visible row count and the `1-X of Y` pagination text.

## What changed

**`shared_web/static/js/table.jsx`**: Removed the active-runs `<tr>` from `<tbody>` and instead append the text (with the ⊕ icon) inside the existing `renderPagination()` span, shown inline after the `start-end of total` count on page 0.

**`decksite/templates/decktable.mustache`**: Removed the active-runs `<tr>` from `<tbody>` and moved it into a `<tfoot>` row below the data rows, so the static (non-JS) fallback table also no longer has a spurious extra body row.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected
- Diff reviewed: every hunk serves #7951; no unrelated changes

Fixes #7951
fix.pr_title: Move active league runs text out of table body into pagination (#7951)

evidence.detail: Active runs text is rendered as an extra <tr> in the tbody, adding a row that only spans 3 columns regardless of how many header columns the table has, causing height misalignment between adjacent tables
renderPagination() renders the 1-X of Y footer where the active runs text could be placed instead
active_runs_text is already passed as a data attribute on the container div, so the React component receives it as a prop
Static (non-React) table also still renders active_runs_text as an extra <tr>

triage.fix_sketch: In `shared_web/static/js/table.jsx`, remove the active-runs `<tr>` from the tbody (lines 61-68) and instead render `this.props.activeRunsText` inside `renderPagination()` alongside the existing '1-X of Y' span. Optionally also update `decksite/templates/decktable.mustache` to remove lines 32-38 and put the text in the footer row for the static fallback table.
triage.notes: The comment in the issue says 'I'm not sure it's worth solving half the problem' because the table header area also has variable height (page-size select only appears when >20 items). Moving the active runs text to the footer solves the tbody row-count mismatch; the header height variation is a separate concern.
